messages:
kevin: Anyone seeing an invoice delta for EU today? Metering shows tokens emitted but final invoice lines are missing for a bunch of customer ids on eu-prod-1 shard.

maria: Saw an alert from billing-bot about `unprocessed_events > threshold` around 09:17 UTC.

sam: I checked ingestion logs — there was a spike in retries from the kafka consumer in EU. Looks like commit lag for consumer-group `billing-ingest-eu`.

elena: Relevant log snippet:```
[2026-03-18T09:17:12Z] billing-ingest-eu ERROR CommitFailed: offsets 12456-12510 not committed
partition=3 group=billing-ingest-eu err=UnknownServerError
```

kevin: Could this be the dedupe window dropping things downstream? Or are events stuck before aggregation?

maria: Dedupe gate was updated in the canary rollout at 08:30 UTC for eu. It should be opt-in `enable_dedupe=true` but I saw a config flip earlier. Might be related.

sam: We had a similar symptom last month — rollback fixed it. I propose routing EU -> global shard until we confirm ingestion is stable.

elena: Routing policy is in `routing-config/service.json`. Quick patch to force fallback:```
PATCH /v1/configs/routing-config
{
  "eu": {"preferred": "billing-global", "force_fallback": true}
}
```

billing-bot: Auto-notify: re-routing EU -> billing-global started at 09:45 UTC. In-flight events will be reprocessed. :information_source: 

kevin: Two action items from me: 1) add a dashboard tile for commit-lag per consumer-group (5m granularity). 2) make the billing pipeline emit `reason_code` on invoice-line failures so we can triage without chasing logs.

sam: I can add the Grafana panel and an alert. For `reason_code` we need a schema bump (invoice event proto v2) and some producer changes — that'll take ~1 sprint.

maria: For immediate triage I requeued the affected window (09:15-09:30) with the kafka-rewind job:```
kafka-rewind --group billing-ingest-eu --to-timestamp 2026-03-18T09:15:00Z --topic billing-events-eu
```

elena: Ops ran the rewind and consumption resumed. billing-bot reports 2,980 invoice lines reconciled. :white_check_mark: 

kevin: Nice. Postmortem next steps: add commit-lag alert to ops runbook, add `reason_code` to invoice proto, and tighten canary gating in the rollout UX so the flag can't slip unexpectedly.

sam: I'll open PRs for the Grafana panel + alert rule and link the proto ticket. Assigning to @sam and @maria for the follow-ups.

maria: I'll draft the runbook and add a staging test that simulates consumer lag.

kevin: Thanks all. Ping here if regressions show up. Closing the loop for now. :tada:
